_note: Ground truth for the correspondence validator, held outside the analysed tree so it is
never mistaken for source. Each fixture carries two lists.
`supported` are claims that are TRUE of the fixture and cite the right lines. They measure
false rejection: any of these the validator rejects is a claim it would have wrongly marked
in a real run. The budget is 10% per fixture, independently.
`contradicted` are claims that are FALSE of the fixture, each written to fail one specific
structural check named in `expect_check`. They measure whether the deterministic half earns
its place: every one must be caught with no model call.
Statements are written the way the synthesis skill asks for them -- actor, action, object,
qualifier -- so the measurement reflects the wording the validator will actually meet.
`entailment_only` are claims that are FALSE but that no structural check can catch without
over-rejecting. They are recorded rather than dropped so the boundary between the two halves
stays visible and honest: the structural half must NOT reject these, and the entailment half

supported.title: List held orders
supported.statement: A client shall be able to retrieve the list of orders currently held, so that the full set can be reviewed.

supported.title: Retrieve one order
supported.statement: A client shall be able to retrieve a single order by its reference, and be told when no such order exists.

supported.title: Place a new order
supported.statement: A client shall be able to create a new order by supplying its details, so that it enters the queue for fulfilment.

supported.title: Confirm an order
supported.statement: A client shall be able to confirm an order, so that its state is recorded as confirmed and fulfilment may begin.

supported.title: Amend a delivery address
supported.statement: A client shall be able to update only the delivery address held against an order, leaving its other details unchanged.

supported.title: Cancel an order
supported.statement: A client shall be able to cancel an order, so that it is no longer fulfilled.

supported.title: Order ceiling
supported.statement: An order whose total exceeds the approved ceiling shall be refused rather than accepted.

supported.title: Report service health
supported.statement: A client shall be able to check that the service is answering, so that availability can be monitored.

supported.title: Load an order record
supported.statement: The system shall load a stored order by its identifier when one is requested.

supported.title: Retain order state
supported.statement: The system shall save an order so that its details are retained between requests.

contradicted.title: Store on listing
contradicted.statement: A client shall be able to create and store a new order by listing the orders currently held.
contradicted.why: Asserts a change while citing an entry point declared read-only.

contradicted.title: Unrelated subject
contradicted.statement: A payroll administrator shall be able to calculate statutory tax withholding for each employee pension contribution.
contradicted.why: Shares no substantive word with anything at the cited lines.

contradicted.title: Whole file cited
contradicted.statement: A client shall be able to manage every aspect of an order through the service.
contradicted.why: Cites more code than can be evidence for one sentence.

contradicted.title: Nothing at the line
contradicted.statement: A client shall be able to export an order to an external accounting ledger.
contradicted.why: The cited line holds nothing the extractors recognised.

contradicted.title: No evidence
contradicted.statement: A client shall be able to receive a notification whenever an order changes state.

contradicted.title: Declaration as a capability
contradicted.statement: A client shall be able to browse the stored orders table directly, so that every order row can be inspected.
contradicted.why: Cites a table declaration that no entry point can reach; nothing exposes it.

entailment_only.title: Internal code described as a capability
entailment_only.statement: A client shall be able to save an order directly, so that the stored details are updated.
entailment_only.why: save_order IS reachable from an endpoint, so the fault is the word 'directly'. Rejecting this structurally would mean rejecting every claim that cites the code behind a handler.

supported.title: Report a reconciliation summary
supported.statement: An operator shall be able to request a reconciliation summary for a period without changing any balance.

supported.title: Reconcile a period
supported.statement: An operator shall be able to reconcile a period, so that the corrected balances are written.

supported.title: Post a manual adjustment
supported.statement: An operator shall be able to post a manual adjustment against a single account.

supported.title: Adjustment ceiling
supported.statement: An adjustment whose amount exceeds the manual posting limit shall be refused.

supported.title: Zero adjustment refused
supported.statement: An adjustment of zero shall be refused, since it changes nothing.

supported.title: Summarise a period
supported.statement: The system shall summarise the balances held for a period when a report is requested.

supported.title: Dry run by default
supported.statement: The system shall reconcile without writing balances unless writing is explicitly requested.

contradicted.title: Unrelated subject
contradicted.statement: An operator shall be able to schedule a courier collection for a warehouse despatch note.
contradicted.why: Shares no substantive word with the cited code.

contradicted.title: No evidence
contradicted.statement: An operator shall be able to reverse a posted adjustment within the same period.

contradicted.title: Declaration as a capability
contradicted.statement: An operator shall be able to raise the maximum adjustment limit, so that larger postings are accepted.
contradicted.why: Cites a declared constant no entry point reaches; nothing lets an operator change it.

entailment_only.title: Internal code described as a capability
entailment_only.statement: An operator shall be able to apply an adjustment to the ledger directly.
entailment_only.why: apply_adjustment IS reachable from the CLI entry, so only the wording is wrong.

supported.title: Send a receipt on order placement
supported.statement: The system shall send the customer a receipt once an order has been placed.

supported.title: Record a settled payment
supported.statement: The system shall record that a payment has settled, so that the order may be fulfilled.

supported.title: Purge expired baskets
supported.statement: The system shall remove expired baskets on a daily cycle so that they do not accumulate.

supported.title: Mark a payment settled
supported.statement: The system shall mark an order as settled when its payment clears.

supported.title: Remove expired baskets
supported.statement: The system shall purge baskets that have passed their retention window.

contradicted.title: Unrelated subject
contradicted.statement: The system shall reconcile quarterly value added tax returns against the filed statutory accounts.
contradicted.why: Shares no substantive word with the cited code.

contradicted.title: No evidence
contradicted.statement: The system shall retry a failed notification three times before abandoning it.

supported.title: Per-order reservation limit
supported.statement: A reservation shall not exceed the per-order limit, so that stock is not held back from other customers.

contradicted.title: Unrelated subject
contradicted.statement: An administrator shall be able to configure the payroll calendar for each regional subsidiary.
contradicted.why: Shares no substantive word with the cited documentation.
